role: A chat line the player typed (truncated to 100 chars); the server runs it through the command parser or broadcasts it.
scope_reason: No chat is ever typed in this game: agents act through the act stream, the chat GUI is among raster_hud.c's not-drawn screens, and the dev ops (give, summon, orb) bypass chat entirely.

members.name: readPacketData
members.note: wire framing; the native engine has no network

notes: Commands the game itself needs (the /summon-style dev ops) run through the oracle's --dev sidecar, not chat; see the dev op notes in AGENTS.md.
